import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router'; import { DossierService } from '../../core/services/dossier.service'; import { AuthService } from '../../core/services/auth.service'; import { DossierSoins } from '../../core/models/models'; @Component({ selector: 'app-dossier-detail', templateUrl: './dossier-detail.component.html' }) export class DossierDetailComponent implements OnInit { dossier?: DossierSoins; loading = true; constructor( private route: ActivatedRoute, private router: Router, private service: DossierService, public auth: AuthService ) {} ngOnInit(): void { const id = +this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!; this.service.getById(id).subscribe({ next: (d) => { this.dossier = d; this.loading = false; }, error: () => this.router.navigate(['/dossiers']) }); } }
